Apple SHARP - unmodified copy of src/sharp from
https://github.com/apple/ml-sharp
commit aed6527499ef91cba3b54c18d49a870f25947190

Code: Apple sample code license (sharp_licenses/LICENSE).
Model weights are NOT included; the user downloads them from Apple after accepting the
Apple Machine Learning Research Model License (sharp_licenses/LICENSE_MODEL) - research use only.
The gsplat renderer module (sharp/utils/gsplat.py) is not used: Stereo3D Studio renders with its own
PyTorch rasterizer (app/stereo3dstudio/sharp3d.py), so no CUDA compiler is needed.
SHARP's .ply export (which needs the GPL-3.0 plyfile package) is not used; a stand-in module replaces plyfile.
